meta_description: Garden Direct Southampton offers professional gardening, garden maintenance, and landscaping services across South Hampshire. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to complete garden transformations, we handle everything so you don't have to.
services_subhead: Whether you need regular maintenance, seasonal work, or a full garden redesign, we've got you covered.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Lawn Care
services.desc: Weekly or monthly grass cutting, hedge trimming, and seasonal tidying. We keep your garden looking sharp year-round without the effort.

services.title: Overgrown Garden Clearance
services.desc: Reclaim your outdoor space from brambles, weeds, and years of neglect. We clear, dispose responsibly, and leave you with a clean slate to work with.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Tree Work
services.desc: Expert pruning, hedge shaping, and light tree work to enhance safety and appearance. All waste chipped or disposed of professionally.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Bespoke garden layouts featuring new borders, decking, paving, and planting schemes. We transform neglected gardens into outdoor rooms you'll actually use.

services.title: Seasonal Garden Care
services.desc: Spring preparation, summer watering services, autumn leaf clearance, and winter tidy-ups tailored to Southampton's climate.

services.title: Turfing & Seeding
services.desc: New lawns installed from turf or seed, with proper soil preparation and aftercare advice to guarantee establishment.

about_pullquote: I started Garden Direct because I hated seeing neighbours overcharged by cowboys.
about_para_1: Garden Direct was founded over two decades ago by a lifelong gardener determined to bring honest, affordable garden care to Southampton and Hythe. Today we're the neighbourhood's go-to service for everything from weekly mowing to complete garden overhauls. We've built our reputation one garden at a time, turning overgrown eyesores into outdoor spaces families genuinely enjoy.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is simple: we listen to what you actually want, we show up when we say we will, and we don't upsell work you don't need. Repeat customers make up 70% of our work because they know us, trust us, and know the price will be fair. If you've had a bad experience with a gardener before, we'll restore your faith.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Our garden was a complete mess after years of neglect and nobody would touch it. Garden Direct came in, cleared everything, and now it's somewhere we actually want to spend time. Fair price too.
reviews.author: Mark P.

reviews.text: Been using them for regular cuts for about three years now. Never let you down, always on time, take pride in their work. Hard to find that these days. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Linda T.

reviews.text: Called on a Friday afternoon asking if they could fit in a quote before the weekend. They came out same day and gave me a proper breakdown of what needed doing. No pressure, fair price, started work the following week. Very professional.
reviews.author: David K.
